crossRefs.note: When you saw a thief, you consented with him, and have participated with adulterers.
Have no fellowship with the unfruitful deeds of darkness, but rather even reprove them.
Lay hands hastily on no one. Don’t be a participant in other people’s sins. Keep yourself pure.
I heard another voice from heaven, saying, “Come out of her, my people, that you have no participation in her sins, and…

translations.web: for he who welcomes him participates in his evil deeds.
translations.bsb: Whoever greets such a person shares in his evil deeds.
translations.kjv: For he that biddeth him God speed is partaker of his evil deeds.
translations.asv: for he that giveth him greeting partaketh in his evil works.
